user.title: Sign in to Google
user.description:
This integration works with your Google speakers and displays, such as Nest Mini, Nest Audio and Nest Hub. It doesn't add the other devices in your Google Home app.

Choose how to sign in to a Google account that is a member of your home. For help, see {docs_url}.

menu_option_descriptions.browser: Sign in to Google in a desktop browser, then paste a cookie. Works for most accounts.
menu_option_descriptions.master_token: Paste a master token you already have.

browser.title: Browser sign-in
browser.description:
1. On a computer, open {embedded_setup_url} in a private browser window and sign in. After you accept, the page may keep loading; that is expected.
2. Open the browser's developer tools and find the cookies for `accounts.google.com`.
3. Copy the value of the `oauth_token` cookie and paste it below straight away. It expires within minutes and works only once.

Step-by-step instructions: {browser_docs_url}

To choose another way to sign in, close this window and add the integration again.

master_token.title: Master token
master_token.description:
Paste a master token that you got earlier, for example with another tool.

To choose another way to sign in, close this window and add the integration again.

reauth.title: Sign in again
reauth.description: Google no longer accepts the sign-in saved for {name}. Sign in to the same Google account again: your devices, entities and automations stay as they are. Until you do, your devices' entities can show out-of-date values or be unavailable.

menu_option_descriptions.browser: Sign in to Google in a desktop browser, then paste a cookie. Works for most accounts.
menu_option_descriptions.master_token: Paste a master token you already have.

reauth_browser.title: Browser sign-in
reauth_browser.description:
1. On a computer, open {embedded_setup_url} in a private browser window and sign in to the same Google account. After you accept, the page may keep loading; that is expected.
2. Open the browser's developer tools and find the cookies for `accounts.google.com`.
3. Copy the value of the `oauth_token` cookie and paste it below straight away. It expires within minutes and works only once.

Step-by-step instructions: {browser_docs_url}

reauth_master_token.title: Master token
reauth_master_token.description: Paste a master token for the same Google account, for example one that you got with another tool.

error.oauth-token-invalid: Google didn't accept the cookie. Get a new one and paste it straight away: it expires within minutes and works only once. Copy the whole value, starting with oauth2_4/.
error.master-token-invalid: Google didn't accept the master token. Check that you copied it correctly. If it worked before, for example until you changed your Google password, Google no longer accepts it: use browser sign-in instead.
error.google-rejected: Google didn't accept the sign-in. For details, see the Home Assistant log.
error.google-unreachable: Couldn't reach Google. Check that Home Assistant is connected to the internet, then try again.
error.google-busy: Google is busy or is limiting sign-ins. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.
error.oauth-token-format: This isn't the oauth_token cookie. Its value starts with oauth2_4/.
error.master-token-format: A master token starts with aas_et/ and is 223 characters long. Copy the whole token.
error.other-account: You signed in to a different Google account, so nothing was changed. Sign in with the account this integration uses. To use the other account instead, delete the integration and add it again.

alarms_and_timers_not_fetched.message: Couldn't get the current alarms and timers from {device}, so nothing was deleted from it. Check that it's online and try again later.

alarms_and_timers_not_fetched_from_devic.message: Couldn't get the current alarms and timers from these devices, so nothing was deleted from them: {devices}. Check that they're online and try again later.

alarms_and_timers_not_deleted.message: {device} didn't confirm deleting the alarms or timers, so they may still be set. Check that it's online and try again later.

alarms_and_timers_not_deleted_from_devic.message: Couldn't delete alarms or timers from these devices, or confirm that they were deleted: {devices}. Check that they're online and try again later.

invalid_alarm_id.message: “{alarm_id}” isn't an alarm ID. Copy the ID, which starts with alarm/, from the alarms attribute of the device's alarms sensor.

invalid_timer_id.message: “{timer_id}” isn't a timer ID. Copy the ID, which starts with timer/, from the timers attribute of the device's timers sensor.

alarm_not_found.message: Couldn't find the alarm {alarm_id} on the devices you targeted. It may already have gone off or been deleted.

timer_not_found.message: Couldn't find the timer {timer_id} on the devices you targeted. It may already have gone off or been deleted.

device_offline.message: Couldn't reach {device}. Check that it's on and connected to your network, then try again.

device_no_reply.message: {device} didn't confirm that it did this: it didn't answer in time, or its answer was cut off. Check that it's online and try again.

device_token_rejected.message: {device} rejected its token, and getting a new one from Google didn't help. The integration keeps asking Google for one, so try again later.

device_not_ready.message: {device} answered “not found”. It may still be starting up, so try again later, or it may not support this.

device_request_failed.message: Couldn't do this on {device}. For details, see the Home Assistant log.

devices_not_rebooted.message: These devices didn't confirm that they'll reboot: {devices}. Check that they're online and try again later.

data.update_interval: Change the update interval. Increase this if your devices do not respond in time. Default: {default_interval} (seconds)

data_description.known_hosts: IP addresses of speakers and displays that the integration can't find on its own, for example because they're on another network or VLAN.

error.known-host-not-ip: Enter IP addresses only, such as 192.168.1.20.
